visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Joeman, a man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit bathroom with white marble tile walls. He holds a white cotton t-shirt covered in red lipstick marks toward the camera, looking concerned and gesturing with his right hand as he addresses the audience. (2) A black spray bottle labeled 'Savon Noir' is shown in a close-up against a textured beige background. Then, Joeman's hands are visible in a bathroom sink as he sprays white foam onto the lipstick stains and scrubs the fabric under a steady stream of water from the faucet. (3) A close-up shows a dark, greasy frying pan filled with charred food remnants on a black stovetop. Joeman holds a blue spray bottle labeled 'Bicarbonate de Soude' and sprays thick white foam over the grease while talking to someone off-camera. (4) Joeman is seen in a modern kitchen with grey cabinets and a microwave. He wipes the pan and the induction stove surface with a white cloth, making the surfaces shiny and black again. He looks at the camera with a satisfied expression. (5) Inside a car at night, Joeman sits in the driver's seat and points to lipstick kiss marks on the side window. He then sprays a blue glass cleaner and a pink bathroom cleaner on the window and wipes it clean with a paper towel. (6) Joeman sits in a brightly lit room, holding two cleaning products and smiling. He explains the promotional deal. Behind him, a collection of cleaning sprays and soaps are neatly arranged on a wooden table.

(5) Car Scene: Slight ambient shift to car interior resonance. More 'pssh' spray sounds and paper towel rustling SFX. Joeman continues to speak at a rapid pace with humorous inflections. (6) Promo Outro: BGM volume swells slightly. Joeman transitions to a professional narrative tone, speaking clearly about the group buy offer. The audio ends with a bright melodic jingle/stinger.
